name: Do I need permits for a mobile home bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for a mobile home bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether permits are required for your mobile home bathroom remodel depends on the scope of work and local regulations in your specific Bay Area city. Minor cosmetic changes, like painting or replacing a vanity without altering plumbing, generally do not require permits. However, any structural modifications, significant plumbing or electrical changes, or expanding the bathroom footprint will likely necessitate permits from your local building department. City Dweller, LLC can assist in determining permit requirements for your project and navigating the application process to ensure compliance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are usually required for mobile home bathroom remodels involving structural, plumbing, or electrical changes, but not for minor cosmetic updates. City Dweller, LLC can help determine your specific needs.
